title: Wrap up at a clean cut
quote: Yes: wrap up at a clean cut.
means: This session ends at a clean cut, not at the goal's end. AIP-1's checkpoint 1 lands, AIP-3 runs its migration once and every thread merges it. Each open intent is then parked with its next step written in its record: AIP-2 checkpoint 4 and Gate B; AIP-3 checkpoints 2 to 4 after the migration; AIP-5's build after the goal pull request to main; AIP-6 to AIP-10 not started. The session record is updated, the finished threads are archived, and a new session picks up from brain prime.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-78 that held
